title: CSF Biomarkers in Prediction of Cerebral and Clinical Change in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer’s Disease
measurement: FreeSurfer subcortical volume; cortical thickness reported separately
limitations: Bilateral average; age/sex/ICV adjusted volume. Table2 reported D retained without deriving confidence intervals; CT not GMV.

title: Multimodal Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Alzheimer’s Disease Patients at Prodromal Stage
measurement: FSL FIRST SIENAX-normalized structure volume mm3
limitations: Table2 heading AD means prodromal MCI-due-to-AD, not dementia. Small sample; regional t tests after omnibus analysis.

title: Relation between subcortical grey matter atrophy and conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease
measurement: 3T FSL FIRST volume
limitations: Abstract-access qualitative corroboration; controls had subjective memory complaints; no regional case-control numeric d recovered.

title: Convergent Neuroimaging and Molecular Signatures in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer’s Disease: A Data-Driven Meta-Analysis with N = 3,118
measurement: CAT12 GMV; Brainnetome246; AAL3 robustness
limitations: Broad lobar evidence does not establish every AAL3 ROI. No per-AAL3 exact d from main text; cannot use 235/246 Brainnetome significant count as 166/166 AAL3 proof.

title: Voxel-based meta-analysis of grey matter changes in Alzheimer’s disease
measurement: coordinate-based VBM GMV meta-analysis
limitations: Cluster labels and SDM statistics are not whole-ROI standardized mean effects; overlapping anatomical subdivisions require mapping.

title: Convergent and distinct neural structural and functional patterns of mild cognitive impairment: a multimodal meta-analysis
measurement: GMV VBM meta-analysis only; separate fMRI arm excluded
limitations: Peak SDM and cluster-overlap counts do not equal whole-ROI effect sizes. Small overlap is low-specificity evidence; several clusters show publication bias.

title: Frontal Lobe and Subregional Volumetric Alterations Across Alzheimer’s Disease, Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment, and Vascular Dementia: An MRI Volumetry Study
measurement: vol2Brain frontal regional volume as percentage TIV
cohort: AD30; aMCI30; HC30; VaD30 excluded here
limitations: Only total frontal effect survives multiplicity correction. Table2 has apparent CI transcription errors for some rows; raw means/SD retained, malformed CIs not used. Bilateral regions not exact AAL3 boundaries.

title: Patterns of Cerebellar Gray Matter Atrophy Across Alzheimer’s Disease Progression
measurement: SPM8 SUIT cerebellar GM VBM; 8mm smoothing
limitations: Cluster FWE p<.05 at voxel p<.001. Paravermal extension not whole-lobule uniform atrophy; peak Z not Cohen d.

title: Differential vulnerability of the cerebellum in healthy ageing and Alzheimer’s disease
measurement: ALE of cerebellar GM VBM
limitations: AD and healthy-aging results separated. AD significant clusters right CrusI/II/VI; lack of other clusters is not absence of association.

title: Atrophy patterns of deep gray matter nuclei in Alzheimer’s disease and frontotemporal dementia
measurement: sTHOMAS nuclear volume; covariate-adjusted group comparison
limitations: THOMAS MD and pulvinar pools are not AAL3 subnuclei. FTD effects excluded. Shared parent effect is not independent evidence for each child region.

title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer’s Disease Versus Schizophrenia
measurement: HIPS-THOMAS normative nuclear volume z-score
limitations: Normative z-shifts are not case-control Cohen d. Nucleus definitions differ from AAL3; MCI stages retained separately.

title: Thalamic nuclei volumes across psychiatric and neurological disorders: a multi-site magnetic resonance imaging study
measurement: FreeSurfer25 nuclear volumes; analyses with and without total-thalamus covariate
limitations: DEM is not automatically biomarker-confirmed AD. Whole-thalamus-conditioned relative increases are not absolute increases; FreeSurfer/AAL3 label correspondence imperfect.

title: Alterations in Olfactory Cortex Volume in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Mild Alzheimer’s Disease Dementia: A Study of Sex-Related Differences
measurement: SPM12 modulated GM; AAL olfactory ROI; left/right mL
limitations: Threshold p<.001: female MCI contrasts p=.002/.003 are nominal, despite prose interpretation; male MCI not significant. Sex strata cannot be pooled without data.

title: Volume and Connectivity of the Ventral Tegmental Area are Linked to Neurocognitive Signatures of Alzheimer’s Disease in Humans
measurement: mean GM signal in probabilistic midbrain nucleus ROI divided by brainstem measure
limitations: VTA/RN/SN ratios show no omnibus group difference; cognition correlation is not case-control volume loss. Table1 VTA AD SD retained as printed; no quantitative generator calibration from this ratio.

title: Substantia Nigra MRI markers are lower in Alzheimer’s disease and are linked to general cognitive function
measurement: 0.75mm SN-sensitive FLASH MRI threshold-defined SN volume
limitations: SN pooled: cannot separate pars compacta/reticulata; different contrast/segmentation from conventional GM. AD small n; MCI sex row counts inconsistent with n.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging Locus Coeruleus abnormality in amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment is associated with future progression to dementia
measurement: LC-sensitive MRI contrast and suprathreshold voxel count
limitations: Authors explicitly state LCVox does not directly measure anatomical LC volume; cannot assign voxel-count effect to FSL-VBM GMV.

title: Molecular imaging of the association between serotonin degeneration and beta-amyloid deposition in mild cognitive impairment
measurement: 11C-DASB serotonin-transporter PET; multimodal PLS
limitations: Raphe molecular evidence is indirect for structural GMV. PLS loading z not case-control SMD.

title: Brainstem Volumetric Integrity in Preclinical and Prodromal Alzheimer’s Disease
measurement: SPM tissue segmentation; TIV-normalized brainstem ROI
limitations: Whole brainstem difference in clinical groups but not biomarker-confirmed subset. White-matter segmentation contributes; not an exact FIRST whole-structure or AAL3 GM nucleus measure.

title: Automated anatomical labelling atlas 3
measurement: Atlas identity; not disease association

title: Structural brain imaging in Alzheimer’s disease and mild cognitive impairment: biomarker analysis and shared morphometry database
measurement: MALPEM/NMM regional volumes; HC-fitted age/sex/total-brain-size residuals
limitations: Total brain size approximates ICV; residual increase is conditional, not neuronal growth. MCI-vs-HC d derived here from independent public group moments; MCI limited to known progression/stability subset. Not author-reported MCI contrast.
